title: Characterization of the constant-one polynomial
statement: Let $\ell$ be a positive integer and let $a\in\mathbb F_2^\ell$. The polynomial $\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1}a_iX^i$ equals $1$ if and only if $a_0=1$ and $a_i=0$ for every $i>0$.
